stemMd: A box contains 3 red striped balls, 2 red plain balls and 5 blue plain balls. A randomly chosen ball is known to be red. What is the probability it is striped?
explanationMd: Knowing the ball is red restricts the sample space to five red balls. Three are striped, so the conditional probability is 3/5.

distractorRationale.d: This is the unconditional probability of red.
distractorRationale.b: This is plain conditional on red.
distractorRationale.a: This uses all balls despite the condition.
